About


PhD Researcher, Cardiff University | AI for Health Equity


I am a PhD Researcher at Cardiff University (Cardiff Business School, CARBS-funded), working on “Reducing Health Screening Inequalities in Wales: AI-Driven Forecasting and Resource Optimisation for Underserved Communities”, supervised by Prof. Bahman Rostami-Tabar and Prof. Paul Harper. My research combines spatio-temporal graph neural networks, fairness-aware machine learning, discrete-event simulation, and qualitative social science to help health services plan more equitably.


Before starting this PhD, I earned an MSc in Computer Science (Distinction) from Manchester Metropolitan University, with a dissertation on “deep learning-based cross-domain facial expression recognition”. My earlier work on multimodal learning, affective computing, and human-centered AI now feeds into how I approach building fair, well-calibrated, and socially responsible AI systems for healthcare.

title: RepoForge AI: Agentic Test Generation for Public Python Repositories
text:
Built a multi-agent system (an OrchestratorAgent plus specialised agents for ingestion, code analysis, API discovery, retrieval, test planning, and test writing) that scans public Git repositories and generates validated pytest suites.
Combined RAG over ChromaDB-indexed code chunks with Gemini-based generation, plus safety checks (secret redaction, unsafe-pattern blocking) to produce reviewable, downloadable test artifacts.

This work was presented at ACML 2025.

Hello, I’m


Roza Ghaedi


PhD Researcher at Cardiff University


I work on AI-driven forecasting and fairness-aware machine learning to reduce health screening inequalities, combining graph neural networks, discrete-event simulation, and qualitative research to help build more equitable public health systems.


   


 Download CV  About me








 Cardiff University






What I do


Areas of Expertise





AI for Health Equity


Forecasting and resource optimisation to reduce health screening inequalities for underserved communities in Wales.





Graph Neural Networks


Spatio-temporal GNNs and attention models for forecasting demand across regions and over time.





Fairness-Aware ML


Building well-calibrated, transparent models that perform fairly across different population groups.





Simulation & OR


Discrete-event simulation and operational research, combined with qualitative work, to support service planning.
